name: Week of Posts
subtitle: A week of drafts, spread across the week, one approval each.
summary: Drafts a batch of posts for the week from your topics and recent winners, varies the formats, and proposes them in batches, one approval card per post, spread across the week.
howToAsk: Fill my queue for the week
get: a week of varied drafts, proposed in batches with one approval per post.
launchPrompt: Draft a week of posts from my recent topics and best performers, and propose a schedule spread across the week. If my analytics are still syncing, ask me for themes first.
